items.title: Cancel appointment if unable to attend
items.quote: Wenn Sie verhindert sind, sagen Sie bitte mindestens zwei Werktage vorher ab, damit wir den Termin anderweitig vergeben können.
items.computation: If cancelling, the letter requires notice at least two Werktage (Mon-Sat, excluding public holidays) before the appointment on 2026-12-14 (a Monday). Counting back 2 Werktage in NRW from 2026-12-14 (Sunday 2026-12-13 is skipped as it is not a Werktag): 1 Werktag back = Saturday 2026-12-12; 2 Werktage back = Friday 2026-12-11. So a cancellation must reach the practice by Friday, 2026-12-11 at the latest.
